svg.aria-label: Every attention head of a character-level GPT, drawn at 5 checkpoints of one training run
svg.text: Every head of a 2-block, 4-head character GPT, 41,472 parameters, every backward pass by hand.
Trained on 353 characters. Cell opacity is the attention weight over the 12 below, from the forward cache.
The upper triangle stays empty throughout, because position i may only read positions up to i.
loss on its own text 3.41 nats, and prompted “to be or not” it writes “ccgecgelsvec”
loss on its own text 1.52 nats, and prompted “to be or not” it writes “he the the t”
loss on its own text 0.08 nats, and prompted “to be or not” it writes “ to be that ”
loss on its own text 0.01 nats, and prompted “to be or not” it writes “ t be that i”
loss on its own text 0.00 nats, and prompted “to be or not” it writes “ to be that ”
Bar under each grid: how many of the 12 positions the head effectively reads, the mean over rows of exp(row entropy).
The mark on it is 6.5, what a head spread evenly over everything the mask allows would score.
